method: Written for new players from the game's rules (wiki pages and patch notes listed below). These are habits, not statistics.
flags: Exactly when Walker backdoor protection turns off isn't verified here — the tip only says to push with your troopers.

items.bad: Last-hitting troopers but not shooting the soul orb
items.fix: Kill → shoot the orb. Unsecured orbs can be denied by the enemy.

items.bad: Never denying enemy orbs
items.fix: When an enemy last-hits, shoot their orb first. It slows their whole build.

items.bad: Chasing kills under the enemy Guardian early
items.fix: Before 12:00 Guardians are tough and hit hard. Let the enemy go.

items.bad: Standing in an empty lane
items.fix: Wave pushed? Break a crate or clear a Small Haunt (from 2:00), then return.

items.bad: Walking around with thousands of unspent souls
items.fix: Spend at every shop visit. Items only help once they're bought.

items.bad: Forgetting to upgrade abilities
items.fix: Check for unspent ability points after leveling — upgrades are big power spikes.

items.bad: Not filling extra slots after a Walker dies
items.fix: Each Walker your team kills gives everyone one more item slot.

items.bad: Selling items after leaving the shop
items.fix: You get 100% back only if you haven't left the shop area since buying; otherwise 50%.

items.bad: Never looking at the minimap
items.fix: Glance every few seconds. Missing enemies = someone is coming for you.

items.bad: Missing the Soul Urn
items.fix: 10:00 and every 5 min after — the timer on the Match Timeline tab counts it down.

items.bad: Walking back to lane after respawning
items.fix: Take the zipline; it's much faster.

items.bad: Walking through Cosmic Veils blind
items.fix: You can't see enemies on the grey side of a veil. Expect an ambush.

items.bad: Using every dash to get into a fight
items.fix: Keep one stamina charge to escape.

items.bad: Never using heavy melee or parry
items.fix: Heavy melee hits hard and breaks crystals/crates; parry counters enemy melee.

items.bad: Fighting a team that has Rejuvenator credits
items.fix: Their deaths come back at full HP after 3s. Wait it out (3 min) or take Mid-Boss yourself.

items.bad: Dying alone late game
items.fix: After 30:00 a death costs 70–90s. Group up and don't walk into fog alone.

items.bad: Hitting a Walker without your troopers
items.fix: Walkers have backdoor protection (65% less damage, 65 HP/s regen). Push with your wave.

items.bad: Killing Mid-Boss and leaving the crystals
items.fix: It drops 3 crystals around the pit. Heavy-melee each one for a Rejuvenator.

items.bad: Shooting the Weakened Patron from outside its pit
items.fix: Phase 2 only takes damage from inside the pit. Go in together.

items.bad: Chasing after a won fight instead of pushing
items.fix: Enemies are dead for a while — hit a Guardian, Walker or Shrine now.
